professionalSummary: Experienced collections team manager with a proven track record of leading a team of eleven agents, managing rotas, conducting monthly one-to-ones and annual performance reviews, and driving operational excellence in a consumer lending environment.
experienceHighlights: Line‑managed a collections team of eleven agents at Northgate Lending from April 2019 to September 2024, overseeing rotas, monthly one‑to‑ones and annual performance reviews.
Approved forbearance arrangements within the team’s delegated limit of up to twelve months and referred longer arrangements to the credit risk team.
Scored five calls per agent each month against the call‑quality framework and incorporated the scores into coaching during monthly one‑to‑ones.
Prepared and sent weekly arrears and team‑metrics reports to the head of operations, detailing accounts worked, promises to pay and payment plans agreed, broken down by shift.
Represented the collections team during the 2023 dialler replacement, testing call scripts and agent screens before the switch‑over and briefing agents on the new screens.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Represented the collections team on the 2023 dialler replacement, testing call scripts and agent screens before the switch‑over and briefing the agents on the new screens; the IT change team ran the project.
Work sample: the team’s 2023 organisation chart and an anonymised annual performance review for one agent, naming the candidate as reviewing manager and the head of operations as countersigner.
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work sample establish the candidate’s experience in line‑management, forbearance policy application, call‑quality assurance, metrics reporting, and collections‑system migration. No evidence is provided regarding the candidate’s experience with production‑level deployment or ownership of end‑to‑end migration projects beyond the described representation role.
